observations.metric: RNA pathway enrichment (HALLMARK, C0001 vs rest)
observations.finding: 26 of 50 tested pathways significant at q<0.05 (min q=0.0003). Top effects: PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS SMD -0.978 (down), HEHE_METABOLISM SMD -0.873 (down), FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM SMD -0.803 (down), ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION SMD +0.783 (up), IL6_JAK_STAT3 SMD +0.759 (up), ADIPOGENESIS SMD -0.774 (down).
20 of 49 features significant at q<0.05 (min q=5.2e-05). VHL, PBRM1, SETD2, BAP1 loci all higher_in_set with Cliffs delta ~0.55-0.58; chr12p higher_in_set delta 0.532.

7 of 107 features significant at q<0.05. CDKN2A loss 36.2% vs 8.9% (OR 5.82, CI 1.83-18.52, q=0.011); chr6p loss 19.0% vs 0% (OR 22.0, q=0.015); PTEN loss 19.0% vs 0% (OR 22.0, q=0.015); chr12p gain 24.1% vs 4.4% (OR 6.84, q=0.039); chr20q gain 24.1% vs 4.4% (OR 6.84, q=0.039); chr9q loss and JAK2 loss 31.0% vs 8.9% (OR 4.61, q=0.044).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Coherent, large-magnitude RNA and CNV signals with strong adjusted significance. RNA shows a coordinated metabolic-down/immune-up pattern; CNV shows enrichment of VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1 locus alterations plus CDKN2A/PTEN loss and chr12p/20q gain. Both modalities are internally consistent and mutually reinforcing.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0001 exhibits a distinct molecular profile characterized by altered chromatin/metabolism-related pathway activity and a CNV landscape enriched for ccRCC-relevant tumor suppressor loci (VHL, PBRM1, SETD2, BAP1) and CDKN2A/PTEN loss. This constitutes affirmative biological support for set identity; no prognostic or clinical claims are made.
limitations: WXS mutation-level evidence was not available in this round; mutation frequency corroboration is absent.
Pathway and CNV findings are relative to the rest of the partition and do not establish external subtype taxonomy.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: C0002 shows a coherent RNA and CNV profile that is the directional mirror of C0001, with strong adjusted significance and large effect sizes. The reciprocal pattern indicates the two sets are biologically distinguishable along the same axes.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0002 exhibits a distinct molecular profile with relatively higher metabolic pathway activity and lower immune/inflammatory signaling, and a CNV landscape depleted of the VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1 and CDKN2A/PTEN alterations enriched in C0001. This constitutes affirmative biological support for set identity; no prognostic or clinical claims are made.
limitations: WXS mutation-level evidence was not available in this round; mutation frequency corroboration is absent.
Findings are relative to the rest of the partition and do not establish external subtype taxonomy.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Adjusted Rand indices are essentially zero for both stage and grade, and homogeneity/completeness are very low, indicating the partition does not recapitulate either label. Grade shows a modest imbalance (C0001 G4=14 vs C0002 G4=3) but this is not reflected in overall label agreement.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: The partition is not a simple echo of TCGA stage or grade. Low overlap does not by itself establish molecular novelty, and published molecular subtype taxonomies were not evaluated.

actions.reason: C0001 has coherent, large-magnitude RNA and CNV identity evidence (metabolic-down/immune-up pathway pattern with enrichment of VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1 and CDKN2A/PTEN alterations), no technical confounder explains membership, and the partition does not echo stage or grade. Cross-modal structure is multi-modal but weakly cohesive with near-zero silhouettes and modest resampling stability, so the boundary is not sharply defined; this residual structural uncertainty is retained as a caveat rather than a reason to drop, since no available evidence request remains and no supported structural revision is indicated.

C0002 has coherent identity evidence that is the directional mirror of C0001 (higher metabolic pathway activity, lower immune/inflammatory signaling, depletion of the VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1 and CDKN2A/PTEN alterations), no technical confounder explains membership, and label overlap is negligible. Cross-modal structure is multi-modal with comparatively higher resampling stability but still near-zero silhouettes and small boundary separation from C0001; this residual structural uncertainty is retained as a caveat, with no available request or supported structural revision indicated.
